items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: recorded by Alan Balter and the Akron Symphony Orchestra

ctx.x: We took – went over there to record it and to perform it. And I’ll mention one other big work: the Jazz Suite for Clarinet and Symphony Orchestra: Three Ethnic Dances, recorded by Alan Balter and the Akron Symphony Orchestra. What else was on there [on that recording] of mine? No, there were three different other composers on there. And we recorded some music for USAir in the Air [the in-flight audio program of US Airways], and that was kind of different. [laughs]
That was with your I. U. jazz band?
